review_notes: I read the whole file and checked the signatures of the two Siegel-set lemmas in Definitions/Def_AutomorphicForm_WindowedSiegelSet.lean. Most other repetition is short: the parallel pow_le_pow_right₀ steps hp1/hp2, and the real-part computations hre/hexp. The `obtain` of exists_forall_tsum_norm_apply_smul_vecMul_le_and_continuous_tsum_of_mem_schwartzBruhat2 appears twice, but the first result `hTS` looks unused. That is dead code, not shared proof machinery. The only real duplicated reasoning is the infinite-place nonvanishing argument for the idele z, which I report. It is small, so this is a borderline finding. I did not compile the proposed rewrite.

findings.excerpt:
have hzu : IsUnit ((z : AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F).1 v) :=
      (Units.isUnit z).map ((Pi.evalRingHom _ v).comp (RingHom.fst _ _))
    exact not_isUnit_zero (h0 ▸ hzu)
findings.problem: Both proofs discharge the same side condition: the archimedean component of an idele z is nonzero at every infinite place. Each proof re-derives it by mapping `Units.isUnit z` through `Pi.evalRingHom` composed with `RingHom.fst`, then contradicting `h0 : z.1 v = 0` with `not_isUnit_zero`. The argument is copied verbatim in two theorems, once inside an `intro h0` bullet and once inside a `fun v h0` bullet. The statement being proved is never named.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma before both theorems.

theorem fst_apply_ne_zero (z : (AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F)ˣ) (v : InfinitePlace F) : (z : AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F).1 v ≠ 0 := fun h0 => not_isUnit_zero (h0 ▸ ((Units.isUnit z).map ((Pi.evalRingHom _ v).comp (RingHom.fst _ _))))

The proof is the existing hzu argument. The type of `v` should match the hypothesis `∀ v : InfinitePlace F, w.1 v ≠ 0` of `scalar_smul_mem_integralWindowedSiegelSet`, and `Pi.evalRingHom _ v` already requires that.

Then rewrite the two uses.
- In `centralScalar_mul_mem_siegel`, use `refine scalar_smul_mem_integralWindowedSiegelSet F hz (fst_apply_ne_zero z) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hh`, followed by `all_goals simp [centralScalar_apply]`.
- In `archHeight_centralScalar_mul`, use `refine archHeight_scalar_entries_mul F (z := (z : AdeleRing (𝓞 F) F).1) (fst_apply_ne_zero z) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ _`, followed by the existing `all_goals`.

Both hypotheses are `∀ v, z.1 v ≠ 0`, so the argument fits both calls. The `?_` count per call drops by one.
findings.benefit: The unit-to-nonvanishing argument is stated and proved once under a descriptive name. Both theorems shrink to a single `refine` plus the entry computations. A future change to the adele or idele representation then needs one fix instead of two parallel edits. The benefit is modest because the duplicated block is only three lines.
